The RICE score can be calculated using free browser tools like the [ProductLift RICE Calculator](https://www.productlift.dev/rice-calculator/) or the [EasyRetro RICE Calculator](https://easyretro.io/tools/rice-calculator/).[[1]](https://www.productlift.dev/rice-calculator/)[[2]](https://easyretro.io/tools/rice-calculator/)

The RICE framework scores projects or features using this formula:[[1]](https://riceprioritization.com/)

RICE Score=Reach×Impact×Confidence Effort RICE Score equals the fraction with numerator Reach cross Impact cross Confidence and denominator Effort end-fraction R I C E S c o r e=R e a c h×I m p a c t×C o n f i d e n c e E f f o r t

Higher scores mean higher priority.[[1]](https://easyretro.io/tools/rice-calculator/)

### The Four Components

- **Reach** : Number of users or customers affected by the feature in a set time period (such as per quarter).
- **Impact** : How much the feature helps each user. It often uses a scale from 0.25 (minimal) to 3 (massive).
- **Confidence** : How sure you are about your estimates, entered as a percentage from 50% (low) to 100% (high).
- **Effort** : Total time required by the team, measured in person-months or person-weeks.[[1]](https://pmtoolkit.ai/calculators/rice-scoring)[[2]](https://sleekplan.com/tools/rice-score-calculator)[[3]](https://easyretro.io/tools/rice-calculator/)[[4]](https://www.productlift.dev/prioritization/rice/)

If you have specific numbers for a project, tell me your **Reach**, **Impact**, **Confidence** , and **Effort** , and I can calculate the RICE score for you.
